skill.name: measure-dont-guess
skill.description: Define hypotheses and measurement criteria before changing code, then use reproducible evidence to investigate bugs, compare performance, and validate features.
skill.summary: Guide debugging and implementation decisions with predefined criteria, repeatable measurements, and documented results.
skill.author: masseater

security_audit.summary: All seven static alerts are false positives: Markdown link labels are not shell execution, and the entropy alerts concern readable Japanese documentation. No evidence found of prompt injection, obfuscated payloads, or intentional data exfiltration. A separate confidentiality risk arises from recommending production diagnostics and logging boundary values without redaction guidance.

remediation.issue: Production diagnostic instructions omit safeguards for sensitive values in logs and committed measurement records.
remediation.suggestion: Require approved diagnostic scope, redact credentials and personal data before logging, restrict log access and retention, and sanitize results before committing them.

content.value_statement: Assumptions can lead to ineffective fixes and misleading performance claims. This skill guides assistants through hypotheses, predefined criteria, repeatable measurements, and evidence-based decisions.
actual_capabilities: Guides hypothesis selection and acceptance criteria before measurements or implementation.
Structures reproducible experiments that change one condition and record results.
Guides root cause investigation through reproduction, recent changes, boundary observations, and failing tests.
Defines performance comparisons using baseline spans, consistent conditions, and regression checks.
Provides repository-specific guidance for Effect instrumentation and Cloudflare Workers observability.
Directs assistants to identify missing evidence instead of presenting unmeasured claims as facts.
limitations: Provides written workflows, not a bundled measurement engine or executable test suite.
Requires access to relevant systems, representative data, and suitable instrumentation.
TypeScript template references require adaptation for other repositories and toolchains.
Does not provide production authorization, sensitive-data redaction, or diagnostic retention safeguards.

use_cases.title: Investigate a Reproducible Bug
use_cases.description: Trace a failing request across application layers, isolate the source of invalid values, and verify one targeted fix.

use_cases.title: Verify a Performance Improvement
use_cases.description: Collect a representative baseline, change one measured bottleneck, and compare repeated results while checking for regressions.

use_cases.title: Define Feature Acceptance Evidence
use_cases.description: Turn feature requirements into failing acceptance checks before implementation, then verify the completed behavior with the same checks.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner: Define a Measurement
prompt_templates.prompt: Use measure-dont-guess for [question]. List hypotheses, the measurement needed for each, and decision criteria before proposing code changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Starting an investigation without a clear measurement plan.

prompt_templates.title: Intermediate: Find the Root Cause
prompt_templates.prompt: Investigate [bug] using [reproduction and logs]. Review recent changes, propose redacted boundary observations, and define a failing test before one targeted fix.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: Compare Performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate [proposed optimization] in [approved representative environment]. Define baseline spans, repeat measurements, report variation, and check regressions after one change.
prompt_templates.scenario: Testing an optimization against a repeatable baseline.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: Validate Across Layers
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan validation for [feature] across [layers]. Define failing acceptance tests, redacted observations, and decision criteria. Identify missing access before any production action.
prompt_templates.scenario: Coordinating feature validation across multiple system boundaries.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Investigate intermittent checkout failures without assuming the database is responsible.
output: Question: At which boundary does the checkout request first become invalid?
Hypotheses: request validation, service transformation, or database handling.
Observation plan: Record redacted boundary values and correlation identifiers in an approved environment.
Decision criterion: Identify the earliest boundary where valid input produces invalid output.
Status: Root cause remains unconfirmed until reproduction and measurements are available.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Determine whether caching improves a slow endpoint.
output: Hypothesis: Repeated reads account for most endpoint latency.
Baseline plan: Measure endpoint and read spans under the same representative workload across repeated runs.
Decision criterion: Agree on the required latency reduction and acceptable error rate before testing.
Experiment: Change only caching behavior, repeat measurements, and inspect other operations for regressions.
Status: No performance improvement is claimed before measurements.

best_practices: Write hypotheses and acceptance criteria before collecting results, then keep experiment conditions consistent.
Use approved representative environments, redact sensitive diagnostics, and sanitize evidence before adding it to commits.
Change one factor at a time, repeat measurements, and report uncertainty or missing access explicitly.
anti_patterns: Treating an unmeasured explanation as a confirmed root cause.
Changing acceptance criteria after seeing results or combining unrelated fixes.
Logging raw production inputs or committing diagnostic results without checking for sensitive data.

faq.question: What does this skill provide?
faq.answer: It provides measurement-first instructions for debugging, performance comparisons, and feature validation. It does not include an executable measurement engine.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: The workflows can guide these assistants. Actual measurements depend on the tools, permissions, and environment available to each assistant.

faq.question: Does it require the referenced TypeScript template?
faq.answer: No. The general workflow applies elsewhere, but Effect and Cloudflare instructions must be mapped to equivalent tools in your repository.

faq.question: Must measurements run in production?
faq.answer: The source prioritizes production and otherwise calls for matching staging conditions. Obtain authorization and define diagnostic safeguards before accessing either environment.

faq.question: What happens when measurements are unavailable?
faq.answer: The workflow directs the assistant to explain what is missing and label unmeasured claims as speculation instead of proceeding on assumptions.

faq.question: How should logs and measurement records be handled?
faq.answer: Redact secrets and personal data, restrict access, and sanitize results before committing them. These safeguards must supplement the source instructions.
